freeze_reason: stop methodology iteration and transition to confirmatory validation

interaction_measurement.k4_retention: four scalar witness projections per complete chronology; no K4 model-space interaction tensors retained

witness_bank.construction: for each candidate final stage j, form the six degree-three full-history predictions ending in j, project the target onto their convex hull, and normalize target-minus-projection to obtain u_j
witness_bank.freeze_rule: all four witnesses must be fully constructed and unit-norm checked using only K3 information before the first K4 active-lift output
witness_bank.single_witness_failure_is_not_a_method_f: the frozen method uses the entire pre-K4 witness bank through an infinity-norm certificate; it does not select one witness after K4 output

certificate.hierarchy: nonnegative K-local order marginals with simplex and adjacent-level marginal consistency
certificate.property_queries: for every unordered stage pair {i,j}, solve the proof-safe multi-witness infinity-norm LP on the class with the wrong precedence orientation
certificate.euclidean_soundness: because every u_j is unit norm, max_j absolute witness projection is no larger than Euclidean residual norm
certificate.solver: scipy.optimize.linprog highs proposes primal and dual values; the reported bound clips and L1-normalizes inequality duals, recomputes reduced costs, applies one simplex-minimum correction per local subset, and subtracts a floating-point guard
certificate.wrong_relation_rule: wrong precedence is certified impossible only if the proof-safe Euclidean distance lower bound exceeds the elimination guard
certificate.true_relation_sanity: the class containing the target chronology must have Euclidean distance lower bound at most the elimination guard
certificate.full_chronology_rule: full chronology is certified iff exactly one orientation survives for every unordered stage pair and the surviving orientations form one total order

theory_scope.terminal_exactness: at K=N=4, the hierarchy contains the full permutation simplex, so the property LP is exact in the retained witness-projection geometry and there is no omitted interaction tail
theory_scope.fixed_k_scaling: the hierarchy coordinate count is sum_{r<=K} P(N,r), polynomial in N for fixed K, and the number of pairwise property queries is O(N^2)
theory_scope.exactness_below_terminal_level: for K<N, the certificate is exact for the degree-K interaction model; promotion to an exact true-endpoint claim requires an explicit omitted-interaction bound or increasing K
theory_scope.information_barrier: without additional regularity assumptions, unseen K+1 interactions cannot be universally bounded from degree-K observations alone; the hierarchy is therefore instance-adaptive rather than a universal fixed-K exact decoder
theory_scope.paper_complexity_measure: interaction certificate depth K-star is the smallest interaction level at which the requested chronology properties are certified under the applicable tail rule

confirmation_case_assignment_rule: target histories were fixed before any heldout codebook output and cover four distinct final stages while varying pairwise order structure

confirmation_success_rule.per_case_success: all six wrong pairwise relations are certified impossible, all six true relation classes pass the target-feasibility sanity check, and the surviving relations reconstruct the frozen target history
confirmation_success_rule.strong_success: 4 of 4 heldout cases satisfy per-case success
confirmation_success_rule.partial_success: 3 of 4 heldout cases satisfy per-case success
confirmation_success_rule.scientific_negative: 2 or fewer heldout cases satisfy per-case success while all runs are otherwise valid
confirmation_success_rule.invalid: any source/provenance drift, exact target replay failure, witness freeze violation, projected reconstruction failure, proof-safe certificate inequality failure, or true target class exclusion

method_change_policy: no witness construction, interaction degree, pairwise query definition, solver correction, thresholds, target histories, or success criteria may be changed after this lock based on confirmation outputs
next_step: implement a confirmation-only runner that instantiates this frozen method for all four heldout cases, pass cheap CI, then launch the four-case confirmation suite without intermediate adaptation
